yisiAI.defaultProvider.description: Global/project model-provider fallback. API keys are never stored in normal settings.

yisiAI.defaultModel.description: Global/project model fallback. Each persisted session may keep its own model selection.

yisiAI.identityBypassEnabled.description: Answer identity/self questions ("what model are you") through a bare chat request with no agent tools and no history, so agent-tuned models answer truthfully instead of role-playing another persona. Normal coding messages are unaffected.

yisiAI.identityBypassKeywords.description: Extra phrases (spacing and case ignored) that should also be treated as identity questions and answered through the bare chat path.

yisiAI.sessionAutoTitle.description: Name a session from its first exchange using the selected model, so the history list reads as tasks instead of "New Chat". Costs one extra provider request per session. A title you set yourself is never overwritten.

yisiAI.pdfVisionMaxPages.description: How many scanned/image PDF pages are attached as images for vision-capable models. 0 = the whole document (a 250-page safety ceiling still applies). Higher values cost more tokens per attachment.

yisiAI.modelContextWindows.description: Per-model context-window overrides for the UI gauge. Applied to ANY model (any provider), so you can add models the built-in table does not know. Matched by substring on the model id; an entry with a windowTokens of 0 is ignored.

yisiAI.mcpServers.description: MCP servers to expose as agent tools (namespaced mcp__<server>__<tool>). Each entry spawns one local process with shell:false and inherits your environment, exactly like starting it from a terminal. An MCP tool's effects cannot be inspected from outside, so unclassified tools are treated as environmentChange (Plan refuses them, every other mode asks, Full Access runs them). Narrow individual tools with toolRisks once you have reviewed a server.

name.description: Name used for tool namespacing; must be unique.

command.description: Executable to spawn. Not a shell line: arguments go in "args".

enabled.description: Set false to keep the entry but not start the server.

toolRisks.description: Optional per-tool risk narrowing: readOnly (runs without asking in every mode), workspaceWrite, processExec, or environmentChange. Tools left out keep the conservative default.

yisiAI.hooks.description: Hooks: local scripts that run at agent lifecycle events. Each entry spawns one process with shell:false, passing the event as JSON on stdin; a preToolUse hook may print {"decision":"deny","reason":"..."} to block an action, and a postToolUse hook's output is added to the tool result the model reads. A hook can only ever tighten: it cannot approve anything, and the permission mode still decides every call. If a hook cannot run, preToolUse blocks by default (set onError to "continue" to let the action through) because a guardrail that silently stops guarding is worse than one that stops the action.

event.description: preToolUse runs before a tool call and can refuse it; postToolUse runs after and only adds context.

command.description: Executable to spawn. Not a shell line: arguments go in "args".

match.description: Tool-id pattern: an exact id such as replace_text, or a namespace such as mcp__github__*.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the hook after this many milliseconds (1..120000).

onError.description: What to do when the hook cannot run. Defaults to block for preToolUse and continue for postToolUse; the failure is always reported either way.
